LanguageData.LP_AwakenedTitan.label: awakened titan
LanguageData.LP_AwakenedTitan.description: A celestial titanborn who has passed through the Gate of the Heavens: divinity has awakened in the blood, and beyond the halo overhead a faint golden divine glow has appeared. Still a titanborn, just one step closer to the divine father. Awakened divine blood is not passed on to descendants.
LanguageData.LP_AwakenedTitan.descriptionShort: All the genes of a celestial titanborn, plus "awakened divine blood" (psychic sensitivity +20%, divine glow overhead). Not inheritable.
